vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: skywork-music-maker
Version: 1.0.2

The skywork-music-maker skill is a legitimate integration for the Mureka AI music generation service. The Python script (scripts/mureka.py) correctly handles API interactions with the official endpoint (api.mureka.ai), manages file uploads/downloads as expected for music production, and relies on a user-provided environment variable (MUREKA_API_KEY) for authentication without any evidence of credential theft, data exfiltration, or malicious execution logic.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements are consistent with a music-generation client for the Mureka API: it needs Python + requests and a MUREKA_API_KEY, and all network activity goes to api.mureka.ai; nothing obvious appears unrelated or covert.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (music/song generation) matches the code and SKILL.md: the CLI wraps calls to https://api.mureka.ai for song/instrumental/lyrics/upload. Required items (python3, requests, MUREKA_API_KEY) are exactly what an API client would need.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the CLI instruct the agent to build structured prompts, confirm with the user, upload reference or vocal files only when requested, call the Mureka API, poll for results, and save audio/lyrics locally. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated system files, other env vars, or send data to endpoints other than api.mureka.ai.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The install spec uses a 'uv' entry to install the 'requests' package. Installing 'requests' is proportionate to the script's use of the requests library. 'uv' as an installer is non-standard in the general Python ecosystem (platform-specific installer), so you may want to confirm what installer will run, but the package itself is expected and minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only MUREKA_API_KEY is declared and used. The script reads this env var to authenticate to the Mureka API and does not access other secrets or config paths. This is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent/always-on inclusion. It does not modify other skills or system-wide settings. It reads the API key at runtime and explicitly states it does not cache credentials.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and limited to using the Mureka music-generation API. Before installing: (1) Verify the legitimacy of the Mureka service and the publisher (check platform.mureka.ai and the skill homepage), (2) Be aware any usage will be billed to the account tied to MUREKA_API_KEY and uploaded audio (voice samples) are sent to Mureka servers — avoid uploading sensitive audio without reviewing Mureka's privacy policy, (3) Confirm what your platform's 'uv' installer will do (it will install the 'requests' package), (4) Consider creating a dedicated API key with limited billing/quota for testing, and (5) Review scripts/mureka.py if you want to audit exact network calls and file write locations before giving the key.
